reviewFlags: Geographic coverage is concentrated on central Andes and Bolivian Mojos, not a complete account of western/central Brazil or all central South America. Do not label report exhaustive.

Chavin architectural construction, stasis, peripheral Wacheqsa occupation and general cultural period are distinct chronologies; preserve original sample/model dates.
Chiripa and AltoPukara800–250BC phase range should not become entire site lifespan; retrieve early and later phases separately.
Iruhito250BC–120CE describes an InitialLateFormative phase, not full settlement duration or all Titicaca settlements.
Paracas CerroColorado, Callango, Palpa and Jahuay require exact site versus region distinctions and source-specific occupation intervals.
Topara ceramic classification does not independently establish a shared ethnicity, polity or language.
Mojos800BCE–1600CE broad earthwork range does not show continuous occupation at every ring ditch or named city.
Casarabe500–1400CE urban centers are mostly beyond query window; do not backdate Cotoca, Landivar, Salvatierra, ElCerrito, SantaMaria or SanNicolas from regional origins.
Unknown population remains unknown smallest-band striped; settlement extent/architecture does not provide a census.
No source coordinates supplied in report excerpts; retrieve independently before placing precise points.
Unresolved language is a coverage/evidence limit, not proof no language or no historical continuity; proposed linguistic reconstructions require specialist sources.
Foundation report is gray literature; retain bibliographic type and compare peer-reviewed dating publications.
Keep connector report and verbatim quotations private; public dataset uses independently verified paraphrases with original citations.
